feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: The Kennedy Center names new artistic director, amid concerns
entry.summary: The center's executive director has named an agent who has worked with ZZ Top and Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee as the head of programming for the arts institution.

entry.title: At least 2 deaths attributed to Isaias after hurricane bashes Florida and Alabama
entry.summary: Hurricane Isaias is blamed for at least two deaths, after the storm made landfall on the Florida coast and ran through Alabama. There are numerous reports of downed trees, with hundreds of thousands of people without power.

entry.title: Opinion: Can I keep the baseball I caught?
entry.summary: What would you do if you caught a baseball during the MLB playoffs? Give it to a kid nearby or keep it? This very scenario played out this week, with a fan deciding to keep the ball.

entry.title: Ongoing lawsuits allege GLP-1s can cause serious harm. But we don't know how often
entry.summary: Scant data about serious adverse effects makes it harder to answer scientific and legal questions about how often the drugs might cause serious harm like blindness or pancreatitis.

entry.title: 16 cozy activities to add to your fall bucket list
entry.summary: Carve a pumpkin? You can do better than that. Fun and unusual ways to celebrate the season, from writing a gratitude letter to making an ancestral altar.

entry.title: After losing ground with Latino voters, Democrats are turning to influencers for help
entry.summary: Democrats are hoping to win back Latino voters who have soured on both parties. They hope Latino content creators will bridge the gap.

entry.title: The Met puts a modern artist front and center (and there's some Jackson Pollock, too)
entry.summary: In a blockbuster show, The Metropolitan Museum of Art places the work of two major 20th century artists side by side: the married couple Lee Krasner and Jackson Pollock.

entry.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
entry.summary: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

entry.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
entry.summary: The protests focus on the Election Commission's voter list revision, which the opposition claims disenfranchises millions. The government denies the allegations, saying the revision aims to eliminate duplicate entries.

entry.title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
entry.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.
